definition.simple: A change where a completely new stuff is created. It's usually very hard to undo!
definition.academic: A change in which one or more new substances are formed. It is also called a chemical reaction.

common_misconceptions: Boiling water produces a gas, so it must be a chemical change (False, steam is still H2O).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: 'Can you easily turn it back? Was a new substance created with new properties?'
